title: Approve a scoped RF test-session authority
description:
Obtain a human disposition for a specifically bounded test session, not a final product grant. Identify exact equipment, build, waveform, frequencies, power, traffic, site, operator, setup, duration and approved protocol. Resolve the legal basis without assuming conducted or shielded operation is automatically exempt.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Review only; this node performs no ports, RF or external actions. No unconditional dependency on optional authority.11 contacts. Clearance applies only to the specified session; changed, expired or denied scope leaves dependent execution blocked or deferred. Final equipment disposition is authority.12.
acceptance_criteria: A recorded denial, no-go or unresolved review is a valid disposition and confers no execution permission. For positive test-session authorization: Require recorded, scoped, explicit approval from Mark for the named action. Bind approval to the exact session, authority evidence and applicable conditions. Missing evidence can produce no-go without vendor contact. Additional amateur, authentication and profile approvals remain independently required. Closing this decision without affirmative matching authorization must not release execution.
